sloka: एवम् उक्तः नृपतिना रामः धर्मभृताम् वरः ।प्रत्युवाच अन्जलिम् कृत्वा पितरम् वाक्य कोविदः ॥२-३४-२७॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ nṛpatinā rāmaḥ dharmabhṛtām varaḥ ।pratyuvāca anjalim kṛtvā pitaram vākya kovidaḥ ॥2-34-27॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to by the king, Rama, skilled in speech and upholder of righteousness, replied to his father with folded palms:
